measured: The commit wrote an effective candidate branch (base_revision 4) and the gm-reason private record, in both runs (readonly census).
The E2E-25 match's multiplayer store keeps all 5 events and has 0 rows in mp_match_events_superseded, in both runs (readonly census).

Code reading that turns the census into a conclusion: rebuildHostFromActivatedBranch's first store write is supersedeActivatedTail(store, matchId, effectiveRevision) (src/lib/multiplayer/server/ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.ts:180-185, :280-288), and revision = sequence + 1 (:276-277), so a rebuild through revision 4 of a 5-event log moves sequence 4 into mp_match_events_superseded (DurableMatchStore.supersedeFrom, src/lib/multiplayer/server/DurableMatchStore.ts:1122). 0 superseded rows therefore means the live rebuild did not run against this match's store.
The guest page's phase-name stays 'Movement Phase' for the full 30 s wait.
inference: INFERENCE (code reading, not measured): the commit route looks the live host up with getMatchHostRegistry().get(matchId) (src/pages/api/matches/[id]/rewind-commit.ts:230) inside Next's API bundle. server.js:455-457 records that the socket runtime's tsx require hook builds a module graph separate from Next's API bundle, MatchHostRegistry is a module-level singleton (src/lib/multiplayer/server/MatchHostRegistry.ts:220-228, whose doc comment at :223 calls it the accessor 'used by REST routes + WS handler'), and no API route creates a host (grep: the only other API-side registry call is closeMatch at src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/[id].ts:120). So the lookup finds no host, rebuildFromActivatedBranch is skipped, and the connected match keeps serving the superseded Movement state. This matches the 0 superseded rows.

INFERENCE (code reading, not measured): even if the rebuild ran on the live host, it only marks seated viewers for resync (ServerMatchHost.ts:584-588); the resync is applied on that viewer's next SessionJoin (ServerMatchHost.ts:903-908), and nothing in rebuildHostFromActivatedBranch pushes a frame to a socket that is already connected. A guest that does not reconnect would still not render Initiative.

Why U21 did not catch it: its receipts record no E2E, build or Playwright run (u21-local nonClaims[0]); its main proof ran jest only (u21-mainproof runtime.playwright: 233 jest tests). The host-level rebuild rows drive ServerMatchHost directly, inside one module graph.
